items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: John Penny must have been about 69 or 70 years old when he came to work with us at the point.

ctx.x: a lot of things went on but nothing like that didn't go on because we had a matron or a hostress or something in the dressing room. Oh, I see. You know, man couldn't go in there. The sport had a trumpet player, did you ever hear this man, John Penny?
